تبتعثوا (form VIII)
# تَبْتَعِثُوا (tabtaʕiṯū) /tab.ta.ʕi.θuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# تُبْتَعَثُوا (tubtaʕaṯū) /tub.ta.ʕa.θuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
